notes.title: Poker Dungeon: Joker Madness - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Poker Dungeon: Joker Madness - Patch Notes[/h1]
Version [0.4] - [15-08-2024]

Greetings, adventurers!
We're excited to bring you a new update packed with fresh content, quality-of-life improvements, and some important fixes. Dive into the details below to see what's new in the world of Poker Dungeon: Joker Madness!

[h2]New Features & Content[/h2]
New Decks:
    Land of the Rising Sun: Embrace the power of the East with a deck that focuses on strategic plays and powerful synergies.
    Legion of Chaos: Unleash mayhem with this chaotic deck, perfect for those who thrive in unpredictability.
[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Control Rebind:[/h3]
You can now customize your controls! Rebind keys to suit your playstyle and enjoy a more personalized gaming experience.

[h3]Improved Visuals:[/h3]
    We've polished the game's visuals to enhance your dungeon-crawling adventure. Expect sharper graphics and smoother animations.

[h3]Better Tooltips:[/h3]
    Tooltips have been revamped to provide clearer and more detailed information, helping you make better decisions during your runs.

[h3]Free 2-Drop at Start:[/h3]
    To give you a better start in your journey, you'll now receive a free 2-drop card at the beginning of each game.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
    Resolved several issues that were causing problems during specific encounters.
    Fixed minor UI glitches.
    Corrected an issue where certain card abilities were not triggering correctly.
[h2]Difficulty Adjustments[/h2]
We've fine-tuned the difficulty curve to offer a more balanced challenge. Early-game encounters should now feel more accessible, while late-game bosses remain as fearsome as ever.
Thank you for your continued support! We hope these updates enhance your experience with Poker Dungeon: Joker Madness. As always, we welcome your feedback as we continue to improve the game.

Happy dungeon crawling!
— The Fishbone Games Team
